favourite.heading: Why Texas Tech can pull away
bullets: Texas Tech is the better football team by 9.6 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+9.6 pts).
Playing at Texas Tech is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Texas Tech by 0.6 points: field position (+0.6 pts).
Scheme fit: Texas Tech 53.4 (#4 of 68) vs Houston 49.1 (#54 of 68) — 50 places on the national board.
Secondary: Texas Tech 62.5 (#1 of 68) vs Houston 51.7 (#41 of 68) — 40 places on the national board.

underdog.heading: Why Houston can keep it close
bullets: Run offense: Houston 55.6 (#17 of 68) vs Texas Tech 45.8 (#49 of 68) — 32 places on the national board.
Offense: Houston 53.8 (#19 of 68) vs Texas Tech 48.8 (#43 of 68) — 24 places on the national board.
QB room: Houston 59.0 (#20 of 68) vs Texas Tech 57.2 (#39 of 68) — 19 places on the national board.
The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -8.7 to p90 +35.3 for Texas Tech, so a projection of +14.3 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
